articles.title: The Tesla Roadster could have stayed vaporware
articles.description: For a car that's supposed to be one of the fastest ever made, the new Tesla Roadster certainly took its sweet-ass time getting here. It's been nearly a decade since Elon Musk made the surprise announcement about plans to build a next-gen Roadster. Now, the Tesla Roadster is finally expected to make its production-ready debut […]
articles.author: Andrew J. Hawkins

articles.title: Fairphone’s latest repairable earbuds are smaller, lighter, and longer-lasting
articles.description: Repairable, ethical phone brand Fairphone has released its second pair of earbuds. The Fairbuds 2 are just as repairable as the first generation, but deliver improved audio and almost twice the battery life. The Fairbuds 2 are out now in the UK and Europe from £99 / €119, and a US launch at $119 will […]
articles.author: Dominic Preston
